## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: everyday safe driving
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The average stopping distance chart on the stopping distance page is a picture with no extractable values, so no stopping distance by speed is taught [A04] (verify MO-SAFE-D-STOPCHART).
The child seat help line and web address on the seat belt page are agency contact details and were not turned into facts [A01].
The child restraint tiers cite statute-level thresholds and were restated in original words, keeping every age, weight and height value exact.
The traffic stop rights paragraph is stated as general guidance in the guide and advises consulting a Missouri attorney; no legal interpretation was added [A07].
The deer crash months and times are the guide's own statements and were not extended.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 60 introduces a chart of average stopping distances of cars on dry level pavement by speed, but the chart is an image with no extractable values; reaction, braking and total distances by speed need a rendered-page review or another official source before they are taught.
